texts.preamble: Virpal And Ors vs Municipal Corporation Of Delhi And Ors on 21 July, 2023
texts.arguments: II. Pass an order directing the SHO, PS Kalkaji to ensure that the petitioners shall not be forcefully removed from their vending sites. III. Pass an order directing the respondents, their official,/ their agents etc. be restrained from harassing the petitioners from peacefully vending at their vending sites. IV. Pass an order for quashing and setting aside the terms of certificate of vending printed at the back side of the vending certificate to the extent which is not applicable to a stationary street vendor. V. Pass any such directions or order that this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the above-mentioned case." 2. 5. Vendor shall not have any infectious disease. 8. Vendor/Squatter shall insure that no hindrance be caused to pedestrian and vehicular moment. 9. Vendor shall not vend/sell any harmful, dangerous and polluted items. 10. The street vendor shall not do any unauthorized/illegal activity. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners states, that they do not pray for the relief of running their business from any particular vending site, within the zone where they have been permitted to vend by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners states, that they do not pray for the relief of running their business from any particular vending site, within the zone where they have been permitted to vend by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi.
